title: Thai Green Coconut Curry with Cod, Aubergine and Red Chilli
summary: Green curry paste and ginger are fried in thick coconut cream until the oil separates, then simmered with the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, aubergine and lime leaves before cod is poached gently and finished with basil, chilli and lime.
equipment: large heavy pot or deep frying pan (about 4 l)

ingredients.item: palm sugar or light brown sugar
Thai round aubergines or 1 small aubergine, cut into 2-3 cm pieces
skinless cod or other firm white fish fillet, cut into 4 cm pieces
long red chilli, sliced on the diagonal

steps.title: Fry the paste
steps.text: Reduce the coconut cream with the paste and ginger until the oil separates.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Whisk in the remaining coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar.

steps.title: Cook the aubergine
steps.text: Simmer the aubergine and lime leaves for 8-10 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Poach the fish
steps.text: Lay in the cod and poach gently until it flakes and reaches 63 °C.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, add the chilli, basil and lime juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste, scatter with more basil and serve with jasmine rice.

tips: Keep the curry at a bare simmer once the fish goes in so it stays in large flakes.
Stir gently; cod breaks up easily.
Add the basil at the end so it stays bright.
storage: Best eaten the day it is made. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour and eat within 1 day, reheated gently until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
